# GitHub team → Jira project key mapping

Sourced from the internal engineering team spreadsheet. Update this file when
teams are renamed or Jira projects are rekeyed — the skill procedure in
`../SKILL.md` does not need to change.

> **Onboarding** is omitted — no Jira project key exists for this team. If a
> discrepancy is found in Onboarding-owned code, the skill falls through to the
> manual prompt asking the user to supply a project key.
>
> **Shopify** work is tracked under `PP` (Product Partnerships) — no separate row.
